expectations.text: The response identifies the charset/collation mismatch (users.email utf8mb3_general_ci vs leads.email utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci) as the reason uq_users_email cannot be used for the join
expectations.evidence: 'users.email is utf8mb3 / utf8mb3_general_ci. leads.email is utf8mb4 / utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci... The B-tree uq_users_email is sorted by utf8mb3_general_ci... So the optimizer can't look up a lead's email in it.'

expectations.text: The response's main fix is converting users.email to the same charset and collation as leads.email (ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY / CONVERT TO), and it says another index on users.email would not help
expectations.evidence: 'Fix the column definition (the real fix)': ALTER TABLE users MODIFY email ... utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci; 'A second index on users.email would be ignored for the same reason'.

expectations.text: The response gives at least one caveat for the conversion on 6M rows (online DDL / gh-ost / pt-osc, unique index rebuild, possible new duplicates under the new collation, or index key length)
expectations.evidence: ALGORITHM=COPY/blocks writes, 'Use gh-ost or pt-online-schema-change', duplicate check under new collation, index size limit (1020 bytes vs 767 on COMPACT).

expectations.text: The response does not flag l.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY as a performance problem
expectations.evidence: 'The leads side is fine: created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY keeps the arithmetic on the parameter side, so it's a proper range'.

expectations.text: The response says rewriting as a subquery would not fix the problem (or does not recommend it as the fix)
expectations.evidence: 'A subquery (IN (SELECT ...) / EXISTS) runs the same comparison with the same conversion, so the plan stays the same.'

expectations.text: The response offers a short-term workaround that converts the leads side so the users index can be used (e.g. CONVERT(l.email USING utf8mb3) or an explicit COLLATE) and notes its caveat (lossy for 4-byte characters / collation semantics)
expectations.evidence: Stopgap: 'ON u.email = CONVERT(l.email USING utf8mb3) COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci' with caveats: 4-byte chars become '?', matching follows utf8mb3_general_ci rules, utf8mb3 deprecated.

expectations.evidence: 'Expected effect: u goes from ALL (6M rows) to eq_ref on uq_users_email'.
